decisions.statement: The root is the nearest folder at or above a path with the akasha domain page.
A root is found on the disk rather than read off the spelling of a path.
A folder's name says nothing about whether that folder is a root.
A path outside every `akasha` folder is refused rather than answered with a wrong root.
The name of the file marking a root is said here alone.
A root the environment states is the root over the one walked up to.
A root stated as nothing is no root stated.
The name the environment states a root under is said here alone.
A caller carrying its own fallback is answered the stated root or nothing.

definition: the akasha checkout a file is in, found by walking up to its domain page
